value.evidence:
Independent re-check by the QA agent for hunter expire76.

VERDICT pass -- the check that recorded this defect now passes, under the definition PINNED for this row. That pin was written by us rather than taken from the failing run, so this is not automatically the identical test; our reason is below, judge it.

WHAT THE FINGERPRINT IS: a SHA-256 of the check function's parsed syntax tree. It changes when the check's logic changes and not when its comments or formatting do. It is the pinned definition, which is not necessarily the one recorded at the failure. Why this row carries a pin, in our own words: The check now judges the newest recorded answer that names a tool, not the union across every answer ever recorded. The old reading could not go green: its one offender, update_bot_settings, was named in NEX-0002 at 10:23 on 2026-09-10, before their 12:37 release, and became visible to us only when the deep pass widened the mention extractor that morning from 3 tools to 8. The original failure this row was opened on is documented in report #85, filed 2026-09-10, when get_event_card_info, backtest_event_card_idea and trade_event_card all returned TOOL_NOT_FOUND; all three are served now. Pinning the new definition, under which the newest answer NEX-0008 names only served tools.

RUN: run-20260910T200633Z-cac9698, preregistration PRE-0083, on a clean working tree at commit cac96988638f514f38f3348bc2c502df594643f2. The selector was frozen and git-tagged BEFORE the run, so the set of checks could not be narrowed after seeing the results.

CHECK(S) THIS COVERS:
  tests/mcp/test_nexus_channel.py::test_every_tool_nexus_tells_an_agent_to_call_exists

EVIDENCE: the request and response behind this verdict are retained under evidence id(s) <redacted> and are provided on request, as are the check's definition and the preregistration named above.

FINDING CYM-every_tool_nexus_tells_an_agent_to_call_exists: Nexus told an agent to call backtest_event_card_idea, get_event_card_info, trade_event_card, and the server serves 62 tools, none of them by that name: an agent following the platform's own guidance cannot act on it
